summary: Update 1:18 pm MYT: Denver beat Toronto 128-109 (Jokic 32-point triple-double), Portland won 132-119 at Phoenix (Booker 33 in the loss), and San Antonio held on 105-103 vs Dallas after leading by 17 at halftime. New Orleans reportedly beat Utah in overtime (from a KSL headline I could not open). Lakers-Kings (one update 89-76) and Heat-Clippers (one update 85-74) are late in the game, but I could not confirm which side leads or find live prices, so no picks. Next slate is small: Magic at Suns (10:00 am MYT Fri) and Heat at Warriors (11:00 am MYT Fri); injury reports and lineups come out before those.

games.note: Final: Hawks 120, Wizards 105. Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 26.
Final: 76ers 112, Pistons 106 - Philadelphia held on late for the road win.
Reported final: Nets 114, Hornets 104 (first home win) - from a Nets recap headline I could not open, so treat as likely rather than certain.
Final: Celtics 109, Bucks 102. Boston blew most of a 21-point halftime lead but won without Tatum.
Reported final: Pelicans won in overtime, Utah's sixth straight loss (KSL headline; I could not open the article for the score).
Final: Pacers 107, Grizzlies 103 - an upset win for Indiana even without Haliburton and McConnell.
Final: Thunder 124, Cavaliers 116. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 42.
Final (per VAVEL recap): Timberwolves 117, Rockets 107. Ayo Dosunmu led Minnesota early; Wolves won without Edwards.
Final: Nuggets 128, Raptors 109. Nikola Jokic had 32 points in a triple-double as Denver pulled away in the second half.
Final: Trail Blazers 132, Suns 119. Devin Booker scored 33 for Phoenix (now 1-5); Portland won without Ja Morant.
Final (per VAVEL): Spurs 105, Mavericks 103. Dallas came back from 68-51 down at halftime but fell just short; Wembanyama had 29 by the break.
Late in the game; one VAVEL update read 89-76 (most likely Lakers ahead, but not confirmed). Lakers were about -11.5 pre-game; no live price found.
